name: io.github.horizungroup/naviscoord
title: NavisCoord
description: Autodesk Navisworks coordination: clash triage, root causes, work plans and reports

environmentVariables.name: NAVISCOORD_OUTPUT_ROOTS
environmentVariables.description: Semicolon-separated folders the server may write reports and exports to. Defaults to %LOCALAPPDATA%\NavisCoord\exports.

environmentVariables.name: NAVISCOORD_SESSION
environmentVariables.description: Pin the server to one Navisworks instance by session id, instead of discovering the running ones.
